audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart read 'Skill' on six of seven rows while the content layer and the packet both give Brand levels 1-4 and Malzahar 5-7.
audit.why: Brand's Pillar of Flame is 900 range on a 10s-to-8s cooldown and Sear is 1050 range on 8s-to-6s; Malzahar's E is 650 and his answer is a level 6 ultimate. The early lane is genuinely Brand's.
audit.corrected: Sides moved to Brand for rows 0-3 with ratings dropped to 4/10, Malzahar for rows 5-6, and every moved why rewritten to argue the same side.

audit.why: Level 6 is the real flip: Brand has no dash and no escape, so a 700-range point-and-click suppression resolves the lane.
audit.corrected: Spikes left as written; the chart now matches them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing warned that Sear cancels your Nether Grasp channel — the flagged missing interaction.
audit.why: Nether Grasp is flagged channel/interruptible; Sear stuns any target already carrying Blaze, and Brand's passive applies Blaze off any spell, so a stray W or E makes his Q a guaranteed cancel.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now states it explicitly with Sear's 8s-to-6s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no digit at all and referenced a nonexistent 'Iron Boundary'.
audit.why: lintFindings COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT; the real numbers are Sear 8/7.5/7/6.5/6, Pillar of Flame 10/9.5/9/8.5/8, Pyroclasm 100/90/80.
audit.corrected: Real per-rank cooldowns written in; the fabricated name removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings under unrelated titles; wants.you[0] called the passive 'Void Shield'.
audit.why: lintFindings COPY_PASTE_BLEED plus packet suspectNames flagging 'Void Shield' against Void Shift.
audit.corrected: Both bullets rewritten to match their titles; passive name corrected to Void Shift.

edits.before: His combo through a broken shield kills you — so the shield is the matchup. Guard it like a third summoner.
edits.after: Blaze is the matchup: keep it off you and Sear cannot stun, so nothing in his combo ever lands in order.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Brand wins by keeping Blaze stacked so Sear always stuns, then chaining Conflagration and Pillar before you reach 6.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. It governs your forward steps. - spell shield (Iron Boundary) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Sear (Q) is 8s at rank 1 and 6s maxed, and only stuns when Blaze is already on you — dodge the follow-up, not the opener. - Pillar of Flame (W) is 10s down to 8s: his poke clock. - Pyroclasm (R) is 100/90/80s. - His Q cancels your Nether Grasp channel, so press R only once Sear is spent.

edits.before: Carry by subtraction — every fight starts 4v5 when your R lands; your job is the wave control that makes the fight happen on your timer.
edits.after: Carry by removing Brand from the fight — his AoE chain needs him alive and casting, and a 700-range suppression ends it outright.

edits.before: Pop-and-punish: poke his shield off with a cheap E-tick, then Q-W-E the gap before it rebuilds — full rotations only ever land on shieldless targets.
edits.after: Silence him mid-cast and Blaze never stacks, so Sear cannot stun you — the silence is worth far more on his opener than on any chip damage.

edits.before: Brand whiffs Sear (Stun) and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Brand whiffs Sear and has no dash — that is a 6-to-8 second window.

edits.before: Trading into him with YOUR shield down — you are the squishiest scaling mage in the pool the moment the purple bubble disappears.
edits.after: Your Q has a delay before the portals fire; silencing after Sear has left his hand costs you your only interrupt for 6 seconds.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport standard — TP doubles your shove-tax map game. Ghost-cleanse setups exist into hard dive; Ignite pairs with R kill threats if you want lane blood.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport standard — TP turns every crashed wave into a map play. Ghost-cleanse setups exist into hard dive; Ignite pairs with R kill threats if you want lane blood.

edits.before: E a caster minion and let the visions farm for you — your lane is a macro pattern, not a duel, from the first wave.
edits.after: Blaze burn plus a level-1 Pillar of Flame chunks you at 900 range — take the CS at max distance and do not contest.

edits.before: Q online: the silence is your trade answer. Use it on his engage spell, not on poke he can walk around.
edits.after: W into Sear stuns once Blaze is on you — hold Q for that window, not for poke you can sidestep.

edits.before: W voidlings turn your shove permanent — the wave hits his tower while you ward, roam-shadow, or just exist safely.
edits.after: Voidlings match his clear, but Conflagration at 625 spreads through the wave and his poke still wins the exchange.

edits.before: Lost Chapter and the machine is complete: E-hops fund themselves, the wave is always crashing, and his tower is always bleeding.
edits.after: Sear is down to 6.5s and Pillar of Flame to 8.5s here, so every CS step sits inside a stun window — farm out and wait for your 6.

edits.before: Survive the level 1-4 poke phase by farming at range and using your passive Void Shield to eat his ambient DoT and W ticks
edits.after: Survive the level 1-4 poke phase by farming at range and using your passive Void Shift to eat his ambient DoT and W ticks

notes: Chart sides were a blanket 'Skill' contradicting both win[] and packet.levelChart; moved to match content, so no win[N] edits were needed (they would have been no-ops). Rows 0-3 whys previously described Malzahar winning while the side moved to Brand, so all four were rewritten in the same proposal. 'Iron Boundary' in breakdown.cooldowns was a fabricated ability name. Malzahar's passive name is not in the kit file; I used the packet's suspectNames correction 'Void Shift' rather than the fabricated 'Void Shield' — flag if the site prefers to leave the passive unnamed.
